units.source_text: “今天也是这只狗到日本以后的头一回。

en.t: Today is also the first time for this dog since it came to Japan.

units.source_text: 万一失败了，没准会生出坏崽子来。

en.t: If it fails, it might end up producing bad puppies.

units.source_text: 夫人内心暗自在嘲笑丈夫，一边又说，“就说母狗吧，

en.t: The lady was secretly laughing at her husband in her heart, while also saying, “Take female dogs, for example,

units.source_text: 什么德国狼狗这些进口狗，不孕症都闻名遐迩呢，

en.t: imported dogs such as German shepherds are widely known for infertility,

units.source_text: 听说一时掉价都掉了一两千元。”

en.t: and I hear their prices once fell by one or two thousand yen.”
